plan: [ This is a sealed-bid second-price auction. With private, independently drawn values and no learning history, the dominant strategy is to bid my true value. Bidding my value ($23) guarantees: if I win, I pay the second-highest bid, which is ≤ my bid, ensuring nonnegative profit; if I lose, profit is zero. Overbidding risks winning and paying above my value; underbidding risks losing when I would have earned positive profit. With one round and unknown opponents, truthful bidding maximizes expected profit. ]

[ In a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, the weakly dominant strategy is to bid your true value. Overbidding risks negative profit if you win and pay above your value; underbidding risks losing when you would have profited. With no informative history and one round, maximize expected profit by bidding exactly your value. Ties are random; bidding above 18 to break ties is harmful, and shading below 18 may forgo positive-profit wins. Therefore, bid 18.0. ]

Second-price auction with independent private values: the weakly dominant strategy is to bid your true value. With v=39 and no informative history (single round), bidding 39 ensures you win whenever the highest rival bid is below 39 and pay that rival’s bid, guaranteeing nonnegative profit. Overbidding risks negative profit; underbidding risks losing profitable wins. Ties break randomly.
